02.lead: Social media is where your brand meets people. We own the entire process — from platform-specific content production to community management, organic growth to influencer partnerships. We focus on real connection, not vanity metrics.

09.lead: AI is no longer a luxury — it's a competitive necessity. We use AI as a strategic tool across data analytics, customer segmentation, creative processes, and campaign optimization. Faster, smarter, more efficient.

product.title: One command center for
product.description: Ordino AI unifies every ad account you run — TikTok, Meta, Google, LinkedIn — into a single operations surface. Plan, launch, and optimize from one place. The AI layer monitors performance 24/7 and takes action without your manual intervention.

01.title: Unified Campaigns
01.text: Build a campaign once, launch it across every channel. Creative variants, audiences, and budgets sync automatically — no tab-hopping.

02.title: AI Optimization
02.text: Our engine reads performance every 15 minutes — shifting budget, pausing losers, scaling winners — transparently, with every decision logged.

03.title: Negative Keywords
03.text: AI search-term analysis clears wasted Google spend in minutes, not hours. The average Ordino account eliminates 23% of wasted spend in the first week.

04.title: Creative Intelligence
04.text: Upload your ad variants — the engine tests them with disciplined measurement and surfaces the patterns that actually move your numbers, not just CTR.

05.title: Blended Reporting
05.text: ROAS, CAC, payback period, contribution margin — a single dashboard that ties ad spend to pipeline and revenue, not impressions.

06.title: Team Workflows
06.text: Approvals, notes, handoffs. Built for agencies and in-house teams running 20+ accounts without drowning in spreadsheets.

01.title: Ingest
01.text: Every 15 minutes, the engine pulls impression, click, conversion, and cost data from every platform you've connected. Nothing is sampled — we read the full account.

02.title: Reason
02.text: A model trained on 230 client accounts ranks every active asset by its contribution to your real business metric — not the platform's proxy score.

03.title: Act
03.text: Budget shifts, pauses, negative keyword pushes, creative rotations — executed automatically in your platform accounts, with a one-click reversible audit trail.

04.title: Report
04.text: Every action is logged in plain language. Your Monday report writes itself: what changed, why it changed, and how it moved the numbers.

aiata.title: We drove global growth for AIATA — Anadolu Group's innovative brand — through 360-degree brand management and integrated digital strategy.
aiata.lead: As a strategic partner to AIATA — a powerful Anadolu Group brand — we manage its digital and operational processes through full 360-degree brand management. To scale the brand's global vision, we built dedicated social media accounts from the ground up for the USA, Italy, Spain, and France, and now manage the entire structure — alongside the main and Türkiye accounts — in a fully integrated way. In this process, we captured strong, rapid growth momentum, particularly on LinkedIn. Beyond social media, community management, and creative work, we delivered professional production services that connect directly with the target audience, and reinforced the brand's innovative face with AI-generated videos. To make digital visibility lasting, we led SEO while running data-driven advertising across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn. We also coordinated end-to-end trade show management — one of the brand's most important arenas of prestige in the physical world — helping AIATA reach holistic strength both online and on the ground.
aiata.brandIntro: A rising name in luxury marine, Aiata Boats produces custom yachts and watercraft with a presence in Türkiye, the USA, Spain, and Greece. Through design quality and global vision, the brand has built a strong position in the premium marine segment.

stats.label: USA · Italy · Spain · France · Türkiye · Main Account
Digital Marketing, Production & Trade Show Management

paragraphs: Bringing AIATA's multinational structure — five countries plus a central axis — together in a single language and at a high corporate standard, while increasing digital performance (SEO and LinkedIn) and representing the brand with holistic communication across physical events and trade shows.

With the 360-degree service capacity we offer the brand, we united digital and physical operations. We built the new global accounts from scratch and applied a rapid growth strategy on LinkedIn. We strengthened the brand's perception through professional production work, AI-powered videos, and SEO optimization. We carried this digital success onto the ground through comprehensive trade show management, cementing AIATA's place in the global market.

gobritanya.title: GoBritanya delivered
gobritanya.lead: We manage Google and Meta ads, visual design, SEO, and website optimization in parallel. The ad campaigns drive over 1,000 customer conversions per month; every channel works within an integrated, measurable growth model.
gobritanya.brandIntro: GoBritanya offers comprehensive guidance to students worldwide on UK education, life, and immigration — a leading digital platform serving tens of thousands of users as a trusted resource.

challenge.head: Making the right decision easier
paragraphs: Going abroad for education is a complex, long decision process for students and families. Ads, content, web, and conversion all need to serve one goal — enrollment.

solution.head: An integrated
paragraphs: We built a measurable growth model that connects every channel. When ads, SEO, and web optimization work together, conversion becomes the natural outcome.

yuva-maya.title: Yuva Maya Launch Management: with our renewed face, we reached the entire target audience in record time.
yuva-maya.lead: We rebuilt Yuva Maya's digital presence end-to-end with a full Growth infrastructure — from brand positioning and creative content strategy to programmatic media buying across Meta and Google. Through the comprehensive launch we executed, we reached almost the entirety of the relevant target audience in record time, powerfully announcing Yuva Maya's renewal across every social media channel. By matching the right medium, the right strategy, and the right creative content, we created a vast digital impact that touched the lives of millions of users.
yuva-maya.brandIntro: As the Türkiye brand of Lesaffre — the world's leading fermentation technology company — Yuva Maya is one of the strongest names in the yeast and flour category. With a vibrant digital community, an extensive recipe platform, and an innovation-first approach, the brand's growth accelerates year after year.

paragraphs: Bringing the renewed brand identity, product family (Instant, Sourdough, Active Yeast), and brand-new face of Yuva Maya — a heritage, well-loved brand — to the most relevant and broadest audience across digital channels in the shortest time, to create maximum launch impact.

By building an end-to-end Growth infrastructure, we combined data-driven performance marketing with creative content strategy. Alongside Meta and Google advertising, we managed programmatic media buying in an integrated way. With our attention-grabbing TikTok operation in particular — tuned to the pulse of Gen Z and Gen Y — we reached more than 8 million people on that channel alone. With a total reach exceeding 20.8 million, we successfully etched the brand's renewal into the minds of our target audience.

turkish-technic.title: Record growth in global aviation for Turkish Technic: we built a quarter-million-strong expert community through B2B ad management.
turkish-technic.lead: For Turkish Technic — one of the giants of the global aviation maintenance and repair (MRO) sector — we managed 100+ data-driven ad campaigns across LinkedIn, Google (YouTube), and Meta. Through our LinkedIn Ads and LinkedIn Newsletter Ads strategies in particular — the heart of B2B communication — we helped the brand surpass 250,000 followers and over 100,000 newsletter subscribers, building a vast community within its own industry. With our multi-channel strategy, we reached more than 50 million people on a global scale. With a precisely targeted 72-hour YouTube ad performance, we delivered the most-watched video in the brand's history. We also stood at international aviation trade shows as Turkish Technic's digital force, successfully running comprehensive event advertising end-to-end for global attendees from around the world.
turkish-technic.brandIntro: The technical maintenance arm of Turkish Airlines, Turkish Technic is one of the most trusted MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) companies in global aviation. Operating in 50+ countries, the company is a recognized force in the global aviation industry.

paragraphs: Achieving pinpoint reach to the hard-to-reach, niche, senior decision-makers of the global aviation sector. Ad investment in aviation (B2B) is far more complex than reaching end consumers; decision-makers are scattered across the globe, few in number, and highly specialized. We had to move with zero margin for error — the right channel, the right narrative, the right timing.

To reach professional decision-makers, we placed LinkedIn at the center of the communication strategy. Through professional ad management and Newsletter ads, we built a lasting audience of senior aviation professionals. By combining this B2B strength with YouTube's video reach, Meta's visibility, and the dynamics of the global trade show calendar, we elevated Turkish Technic to a global authority in digital.

tff.title: TFF launched
tff.lead: AI-powered ad film production sits at the center of our work with TFF. We redefined traditional production with AI — producing faster, more scalable content that pushes creative boundaries. These projects, which reached millions of football fans, demonstrate concretely how powerful AI-assisted media production can be for public sports institutions.
tff.brandIntro: TFF is the central governing authority of Turkish football, an institutional force followed closely by millions of fans through its national leagues and team organizations. At this intersection of sport and society, communication matters more than ever.

challenge.head: Redefining traditional
paragraphs: In large-scale institutional communication, speed and scale don't always come together with traditional production methods. Creative boundaries must expand without quality dropping.

solution.head: Scalable production
paragraphs: By integrating AI into the creative process, we expanded production speed and scale. Traditional quality met next-generation velocity.

turizm-bakanligi.title: Ad Management for Institutions of the Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Culture and Tourism: a historic record with 200,000 applications for Türkiye Scholarships!
turizm-bakanligi.lead: For heritage institutions representing Türkiye's global vision — such as Türkiye Scholarships, TİKA (the Turkish Cooperation and Coordination Agency), and the General Directorate of Museums, all affiliated with the Ministry of Culture and Tourism — we developed comprehensive digital strategies. To strengthen these valuable institutions' standing in the national and international arena, we took on data-driven ad management across Meta and Google. With our innovative approach, we integrated AI-powered film production into public communication. Within the Türkiye Scholarships project in particular, the global application-gathering campaign we ran generated more than 200,000 qualified applications, playing a critical role in reaching the highest number of applications in the history of Türkiye Scholarships.
turizm-bakanligi.brandIntro: Charged with carrying Türkiye's historic and cultural wealth to the world, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism runs one of the country's most powerful institutional communication platforms. Projects across its various directorates make national culture and tourism potential visible on a global scale.

stats.label: TİKA, General Directorate of Museums & Türkiye Scholarships
Reaching Audiences from Around the World

paragraphs: Telling the vision of institutions that represent Türkiye's cultural diplomacy, educational opportunities, and historic heritage (Türkiye Scholarships, TİKA, the General Directorate of Museums) to billions of people on a global scale, accurately. At the same time, in a large-scale organization like Türkiye Scholarships, capturing the attention of tens of thousands of talented students from around the world and converting them into applications (leads).

We combined the sensitivity of public communication with the agility of performance marketing and the power of AI innovation. We designed audience-focused ad strategies on Meta and Google, tailored to the needs of different institutions (TİKA, Museums, Türkiye Scholarships). To boost engagement, we produced innovative AI-powered films. Through precise targeting and creative communication, we set a historic record in the Türkiye Scholarships campaign, gathering more than 200,000 applications.

allium-bodrum.title: Allium Bodrum accelerated season turnaround by
allium-bodrum.lead: For Allium Bodrum, we own digital ad management — ensuring the brand meets the right audience on the right platforms. With the aesthetic sensibility and precise targeting that boutique hospitality demands, we design every campaign in tune with the brand's identity.
allium-bodrum.brandIntro: One of Bodrum's most distinguished hotels, Allium offers a unique stay that blends the warmth of local culture with international comfort standards. With a boutique identity and meticulous service, it's one of the most respected names in luxury tourism.

challenge.head: Precision targeting
paragraphs: Ad investment in boutique hospitality demands a different discipline than mass campaigns. The high-value guest profile, aesthetic voice, and brand identity — all three must be preserved at every touchpoint.

solution.head: Campaigns designed in
paragraphs: We approach ad management not just as performance but as brand consistency. Every campaign is designed in an aesthetic language true to the brand's essence.

marie-claire.title: Competitive SEO Consultancy and Data-Driven Ad Management for Marie Claire Türkiye
marie-claire.lead: For the Türkiye edition of Marie Claire — one of the world's most recognized women's magazines — we manage comprehensive SEO consultancy and multi-channel digital growth end-to-end. As we carry the strength of this heritage editorial brand — a defining voice in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle — into digital, we go beyond traditional optimization, implementing competitive AI SEO and Social Media SEO strategies as well. By integrating organic growth with performance-focused advertising across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn, we strengthen the brand's leadership in the digital ecosystem — across both search engines and social networks.
marie-claire.brandIntro: The Türkiye edition of Marie Claire reaches millions of readers through its established editorial identity and strong digital platforms. It remains a defining reference in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle.

stats.label: Reaching the Target Audience (Women) in Domestic Ad Campaigns

paragraphs: Increasing the digital visibility of a heritage editorial brand with a vast content archive, in line with modern algorithms. The need to capture not only website traffic but also the dynamics of social search (Social SEO) and artificial intelligence (AI SEO), while seamlessly supporting organic growth with Google, Meta, and LinkedIn advertising.

Taking the traditional SEO approach a step further, we applied a competitive consultancy model that also encompasses AI and Social Media SEO. We combined content optimization, technical SEO, and keyword strategy with our Meta, Google, and LinkedIn ad management. As a result, SEO and advertising fed one another, and by reaching more than 10 million women in the Türkiye market alone, we maximized the digital impact of the editorial legacy.

fortune.title: Next-Generation SEO and a Multi-Channel Digital Performance Strategy for Fortune
fortune.lead: To expand the digital authority of Fortune — one of the most prestigious publications in business, economy, and finance — we apply an innovative, competitive growth strategy. We take our comprehensive SEO consultancy beyond traditional methods, integrating it with the dynamics of AI SEO and Social Media SEO that set search trends. To reach business professionals, entrepreneurs, and C-level executives at exactly the right moments, we manage Google, Meta, and LinkedIn advertising end-to-end. Through the X Ads operations we run on X (formerly Twitter) — where the pulse of news and finance beats in real time — we maximize the brand's real-time engagement power and reader traffic.
fortune.brandIntro: Following the pulse of business, Fortune Türkiye is one of the country's leading business and economy publications — producing content for a broad readership that spans C-suite executives to young professionals.

stats.label: Direct Reach to the Business & Finance Audience
Integrated Ad Management Across Meta, Google, LinkedIn & X
Organic Authority Growth in the Economy & Business News Category

paragraphs: Sustaining Fortune's vision in digital without interruption, in a sector like economy, finance, and business where competition and the flow of information are measured in seconds. Reaching a niche, selective readership of professionals at the right time and with the right ad setup — both within the complex algorithms of search engines (SEO) and in real-time social media feeds.

We brought the brand's strong editorial foundation together with a next-generation digital architecture. We aggressively supported search engine organic traffic with AI and Social Media SEO tactics. To reach decision-makers we used LinkedIn effectively, and to capture the real-time agenda we used X (Twitter) Ads; by blending this with the broad reach capacity of Google and Meta, we grew Fortune's digital market share for the long term.

anadolu-motor.titleTail: and cut cost per lead by
anadolu-motor.lead: For Anadolu Motor, we support email campaigns, website optimization, and copywriting. At every touchpoint, we build a consistent, clear, persuasive voice — strengthening the brand's digital presence.
anadolu-motor.brandIntro: One of Türkiye's most established automotive distributors, Anadolu Motor remains a trusted, recognized name in the industry — backed by a broad dealer network and a diverse brand portfolio.

challenge.head: A digital voice for
paragraphs: For a heritage automotive brand, consistency, simplicity, and persuasive power matter most in digital communication. Email, web, copy — every touchpoint must speak the same language.

solution.head: A unified
paragraphs: We manage every touchpoint with the same linguistic discipline. Email, web, and copy form a single, coherent, persuasive flow.

instyle.title: Global aesthetic,
instyle.lead: For InStyle Türkiye — one of the leading names in fashion and lifestyle — we own ad management and content strategy. We keep the brand's dynamic, inspiring voice alive on digital platforms, designing every campaign to speak to local audiences while preserving InStyle's global aesthetic.
instyle.brandIntro: An international reference in fashion and lifestyle, InStyle stands out as one of Türkiye's most active style and trend platforms. Blending global vision with a local touch, the brand remains a powerful, inspiring voice in digital.

challenge.head: Telling a global brand's story
paragraphs: For the local edition of an international brand, the right balance between global aesthetic and local tone must be struck. Brand voice must stay consistent across every platform.

solution.head: Platform management
paragraphs: We design every campaign in a local voice without compromising the global aesthetic, keeping the brand's voice alive and consistent across digital platforms.

inspera.title: A consistent brand voice for a
inspera.lead: For Inspera — built at the heart of Bodrum's culture and arts scene — we own digital ad management. From Livaneli Stage to the Art Academy, from Voyn Kitchen & Bar to the Design Store, we design targeted campaigns that connect this multi-layered experience with the right audience, carrying the brand's distinct voice across every platform.
inspera.brandIntro: Inspera Bodrum Culture & Arts brings culture, art, and life under one roof — with its stages, art academy, gastronomy, and design store. Adding color to Bodrum's cultural scene, this distinct venue gains national attention through the stage that bears Zülfü Livaneli's name.

challenge.head: Telling a multi-layered venue
paragraphs: A stage, an academy, a restaurant, and a store — all at once. Each unit addresses a different audience, but the brand's unity must hold at every touchpoint.

solution.head: Targeted campaigns,
paragraphs: While we set separate audience strategies for each unit, we preserve the brand's distinct voice in every campaign — with flexible planning that matches the event calendar's tempo.
